title: Men's Face Shapes: The Ultimate Guide to Finding Your Shape & Style
summary: Discover your face shape and unlock the best hairstyles, beard styles, and glasses for you. This guide covers all shapes with examples & AI solutions.
body_markdown:
The right haircut or beard style isn't just about the latest trend—it's about geometry. Understanding your face shape is the single most important factor for choosing a style that accentuates your jawline, balances your proportions, and elevates your entire look. This no-nonsense guide is designed specifically for men to help you identify your shape and find the styles that work best for you.


## The 6 Core Face Shapes for Men (with Celebrity Examples)


While faces come in all shapes and sizes, they generally fall into one of seven core categories. Find yours below.


### The Square Face Shape


**Characteristics:** A strong, angular jaw is the hallmark of the square face. The forehead, cheekbones, and jaw are all nearly the same width, creating a chiseled, masculine silhouette. **Celebrities:** Brad Pitt, Henry Cavill, Arnold Schwarzenegger.


Image Source:[@bradpittofficial](https://www.instagram.com/p/DLZ7ZQXNjF4/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==)


### The Oval Face Shape


**Characteristics:** Considered highly versatile due to its balanced proportions. The face is slightly longer than it is wide, with a softly rounded jawline. **Celebrities:** George Clooney, Adam Levine, Chris Hemsworth.


Image Source:[@george_clooney_page](https://www.instagram.com/p/xmG7YhIG5k/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==)


### The Rectangle Face Shape


**Characteristics:** Longer than it is wide, the square face features a strong jawline and a forehead and cheekbones of a similar width. It's like a stretched-out square face. **Celebrities:** Ben Affleck, Eminem, Tom Ford.


Image Source:[@benaffleckkofficial](https://www.instagram.com/p/DLVcNz7NAKN/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==)


### The Diamond Face Shape


**Characteristics:** This rare face shape has a narrow forehead and jawline, with the widest point at the cheeks. The chin is often pointed.


**Celebrities:** Robert Pattinson, Cillian Murphy, Johnny Depp.


Image Source:[@benaffleckkofficial](https://www.instagram.com/p/BpMwMGNnAOr/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==)


### The Triangle Face Shape


**Characteristics:** The jawline is the most prominent feature of this face shape, which is wider than the cheekbones and forehead. The chin is square or flat at the bottom.


**Celebrities:** Keanu Reeves, Ryan Gosling, Chris Pine.


Image Source:[@keanureeves.media](https://www.instagram.com/p/DKR4UVSsHgN/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==)


### The Heart Face Shape


**Characteristics:** This face shape is widest at the forehead and gradually narrows down to a pointed chin. The cheekbones are high and the chin is pointy.


**Celebrities:** Bradley Cooper, Ryan Reynolds, Nick Jonas.


Image Source:[@bradleycooperroffical](https://www.instagram.com/p/DJZ3KCxNojY/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==)

## The Definitive Style Guide: Best Hairstyles & Beards for Your Face Shape


Once you know your shape, you can unlock your best look. Here’s a quick guide to the most flattering hairstyles and beard styles for each shape.


### Styles for a Square Face


- **Best Hairstyles:** Softer styles with some texture or volume on top work well. Consider a textured crop, a side part with some height, or even a clean buzz cut to emphasize your strong features.
- **Best Beard Styles:** Goatees and circle beards can help to elongate the face. Keeping the beard shorter on the sides and fuller on the chin adds balance.


### Styles for an Oval Face


- **Best Hairstyles:** Almost anything goes. You can pull off a classic side part, a voluminous quiff, or even longer hair. The key is to avoid styles with heavy fringes that can make your face look rounder.
- **Best Beard Styles:** A clean-shaven look or a short, well-maintained beard like a classic stubble or a corporate beard looks best.


### Styles for a Rectangle Face


- **Best Hairstyles:** The goal is to add width, not height. Avoid high-volume pompadours. Styles like a side part, a layered bro flow, or a crop with a fringe are excellent choices.
- **Best Beard Styles:** Fuller on the cheeks, shorter on the chin. A heavy stubble or a full beard that adds width to the jawline is ideal. Avoid long goatees.


**Pro Tip:** Unsure if a hairstyle will work for you? Use our **[Virtual Hairstyle Try-On](https://www.perfectcorp.com/business/showcase/virtual-hairstyles)** to see it on your face before you commit!


### Styles for a Diamond Face


- **Best Hairstyles** : Opt for styles that add width to your forehead and jawline, such as textured fringes, messy quiffs, or medium-length layered cuts. Avoid very tight fades or overly sharp styles that emphasize cheekbones.
- **Best Beard Styles** : A fuller beard works best, as it balances a narrow chin. Try a box beard, short boxed beard, or even a well-groomed full beard to add definition to the jawline.


### Styles for a Triangle Face


- **Best Hairstyles** : Choose hairstyles that add volume on top to offset a wider jaw, like pompadours, wavy longer tops, or side-swept styles. Avoid haircuts that leave too much volume around the jawline.
- **Best Beard Styles** : Keep facial hair light to prevent emphasizing the jaw further. A minimal stubble or a neat goatee can balance the look without adding bulk.


### Styles for a Heart Face


- **Best Hairstyles** : Go for medium-length styles that create balance around the forehead, such as side parts, textured crops, or longer swept-back styles. Avoid very short cuts that make the forehead look wider.
- **Best Beard Styles** : A beard that adds fullness to the chin works best. A rounded beard, extended goatee, or short boxed beard helps balance a narrow chin.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### What is the most attractive face shape for a man?


While a strong, square jawline is often traditionally seen as masculine, there is no single "most attractive" shape. The most attractive look comes from having a style (hair and beard) that is well-balanced with your specific facial features, which is achievable for any face shape.


### Can a beard change your face shape?


Absolutely. A beard is one of the most powerful tools a man can use to visually alter his face shape. A long beard can elongate a round face, while a wide beard can add strength to a narrow chin. It's all about creating illusions with lines and volume.


### How can I make my jawline look stronger?


Besides fitness and diet, the right haircut and beard can make a huge difference. A shorter haircut often makes the jawline appear more prominent. For beards, a style that is sharply defined along the jaw and cheek line (like a well-maintained stubble or a short boxed beard) can create a much stronger and more chiseled look.
